tests.title: parses threshold shorthand, named options, AV_OPT_TYPE_INT expressions and rounding into frozen steps
registers a frozen frame descriptor flagged on every path with native formats in table order

observes AbortSignal before and during row processing
compiles linear chains and frame graphs, refusing width-1 planes at plan time
matches native inflate kernels across formats, sizes, thresholds, patterns and borders

details: 264 rawvideo kernel comparisons (6 frames each) via compileVideoFilterChain vs native -vf
112 linear CLI rawvideo/framecrc comparisons through the public frontend
48 timed-backend comparisons (producer, activation, pull) against 16 native outputs
11 refusal cases: native stderr message checked for 7, native success checked for 4 scope-only refusals

unsupported: High-bit-depth formats and formats outside the shared negotiation table (yuv440p, yuv411p, yuv410p, yuvj*, yuva422p/444p, gbrap, inflate16)
enable= timeline, generic context options threads/thread_type/extra_hw_frames, runtime commands
Filtered (nonzero-threshold) planes narrower than two pixels (native reads past the row); threshold-0 width-1 planes are supported
Known unrefused divergence: packed-alpha RGB sources (rgba/bgra/argb/abgr) whose inflate negotiation group is not merged with a table format; native negotiates gbrap, absent from the shared table

proposedContracts.name: fails like native for unknown and out-of-range inflate options and refuses filtered width-1 planes before opening outputs
proposedContracts.scope: unknown/out-of-range option messages vs native stderr; enable= and filtered width-1 planes refused before outputs open

notes: All five paths flagged; the unchanged registry test passes on every path.
The width-1 refusal applies only to planes with a nonzero threshold; threshold-0 planes are copied as native does, verified against native at 1x4 and 2xN chroma.

Unknown options use native wording "Error applying option '<key>' to filter 'inflate': Option not found"; out-of-range uses "Numerical result out of range". For 'nan' our suffix differs (out of range vs native Invalid argument); the test checks only the common prefix.
Needed shared edit not made: adding gbrap to packages/avfilter/src/video-ops/formats.ts negotiation table would remove the packed-alpha RGB divergence.
